correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the source normalization and projective map before expanding. At \(t=-1\), the published ODE and endpoint derivative give \(r_n(-1+s)=-k_n^{-(2n+1)/n}s^{n-1}+o(s^{n-1})\), and two integrations give the stated \(s^{n+1}\) correction. At \(t=1\), setting \(q=-r_n'\) yields \(q' /q^{n+2}\to k_n^{(n-1)/n}\), which gives the \(s^{n/(n+1)}\) profile correction. The exact projective radius is then inverted at zero and infinity; coefficient simplifications were independently replayed. Convexity proves the exact Lipschitz constant and strict slope ordering, and elementary conjugacy arguments prove the dual zero-set and exact effective-domain statements. No finite experiment is used to infer an infinite statement.

value.rationale: The source introduces genuinely new nonquadratic equality functions only implicitly through a calibrated profile. The present result converts that implicit geometry into exact analytic boundary data: it identifies both first nonlinear correction exponents and coefficients, proves the exact global Lipschitz constant, and shows that the primal endpoint slopes are reciprocal. These facts expose the sharp primal-dual geometry of the extremizer and yield a new strict constraint on the otherwise implicitly defined scalar maximizer. This is a structural analysis of the new equality family rather than an arbitrary parameter evaluation or a recomputation of the sharp constant.
